overlay.ready: Press “Start” or an arrow key to begin.
overlay.paused: Paused. Space or “Resume” to go on.
overlay.over: Game over – {score, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.
overlay.won: The whole board is full. There is no more room.

helpKeys: Steer with the arrow keys or W, A, S, D. Space or P pauses. The game pauses by itself when you switch windows.
helpTouch: Swipe on the board or use the direction pad. Tap the board to resume after a pause.
truth: The board has exactly 400 squares, and every bite makes the snake longer. Like memory: it is finite, and sooner or later it is full.
played: {count, plural, one {# game played} other {# games played}} – counted anonymously.

announce.over: Game over with {score, plural, one {# point} other {# points}}.
